Done   always . 1 content . applies to 3 copies . <root>
    projects/a/LICENSE   (named)
    projects/b/LICENSE
    projects/c/LICENSE
  - these copies no longer count as duplicates; filo set FILE --duplicates counted undoes it

$ filo set <root>/terms/2020.pdf <root>/terms/2021.pdf --duplicates records

    terms/2020.pdf   (named)
    terms/2021.pdf   (named)
  - the copies named are kept as separate records, each with its own retention; filo set FILE --duplicates counted undoes it
